item.title: 0.8.1-beta.3
item.description:
Aki 0.8.1 beta 3

New

  • Settings → Agents → "What Aki found": whether Aki sees the Claude and Codex apps, their terminals and their limits, with "Search again".
  • Right-click a limits ring: "Search again" and "What Aki found…".
  • A limits ring shows as soon as Aki sees Claude or Codex, empty until its numbers come, and right after "Connect".

Fixed

  • Claude's limits ring shows for people who use the Claude app and not Claude Code.

item.title: 0.8.1-beta.1
item.description:
Aki 0.8.1 beta 1

New

  • Settings → Agents → "What Aki found": whether Aki sees the Claude and Codex apps, their terminals and their limits, with "Search again".

Fixed

  • Claude's limits ring shows for people who use the Claude app and not Claude Code.

Aki 0.8.0

Faster, lighter

  • Aki no longer slows the Mac down: apps it looked into while you marked (Chrome, the Claude and ChatGPT apps) go back to normal afterwards, and Aki does far less in the background.
  • Marking opens at once, like the Mac's own screenshot.

New

  • "Wake the agent after" can be set to instant.
  • Each ring shows a small badge of the app it runs in (Orca, the Claude or Codex app, Terminal…), and the apps' rings show the conversation you last sent to.
  • A limits ring turns whenever its AI is at work, also while the Claude or Codex app is answering. Codex turns blue, the colour of its icon.
  • Under a limits ring, "PACE": how much you've used against an even week so far (under 100% is on track).

Fixed

  • "Connect" works for people who only use the Claude or ChatGPT/Codex app.
  • Sending to the Claude and Codex apps works in a new conversation, with the app minimized or just opened, and with the focus elsewhere in it.
  • No more "Resources" ring from the Codex app.

Aki 0.7.1

Fixed

  • A mark on a localhost page goes to the session serving that page's port, also in a browser window that isn't the one in front (another screen) and right after you were in another session's tab.
  • Send in the History's queue held every mark back with just a beep when one of them was meant for a session that had closed; now the others go, and that one asks where to go.

Changed

  • A Codex ring in a terminal shows the name Codex gave the conversation instead of the folder; an app's ring shows the conversation its window names.

Aki 0.7.0

New

  • Codex's and Claude's desktop apps are destinations too: with one open, it shows as a ring, and its marks are pasted into the conversation open in it, pictures and all, and sent.

Fixed

  • A Codex session working with subagents keeps showing it's working.
